name: Huang Jin Gui
parentage: Selected from the native Anxi heirloom population.
description: 'Golden Osmanthus'. A classic Anxi oolong celebrated for its singular, intense, and unmistakable aroma of sweet osmanthus flowers. It is an early-budding and high-yielding cultivar, prized for its ability to produce a light, crisp, and almost perfume-like tea that serves as a benchmark for pure floral aroma.
plantType: Early-budding, productive, spreading bush (Camellia sinensis var. sinensis).
environment: Thrives in the Hukou area of Anxi county, where the specific terroir is said to produce the most fragrant expression of the cultivar.
processing: The processing of Huang Jin Gui is a race against time to capture its volatile aromatics. The leaves are delicate and require gentle handling and a short processing window.
oxidation: Oxidation is very light (10-20%), just enough to eliminate the green, grassy notes and allow the powerful osmanthus fragrance to fully emerge.
roasting: Completely unroasted, aside from a final low-temperature bake for drying and stabilization. Any significant roasting would erase its signature character.
versatility: Not versatile at all. Huang Jin Gui is a master of a single craft: producing an intensely aromatic, light-bodied green oolong. Its entire value is based on this specialization.

Anxi Oolong (Light & Aromatic).Huang Jin Gui Oolong: This is its one and only famous expression. It is processed as a very green, unroasted oolong to capture its fleeting, powerful osmanthus fragrance at its peak.

sensory.aroma: Overwhelming sweet Osmanthus, perfume-like, fresh flowers
sensory.flavor: Light, crisp, sweet, and intensely floral with a clean, brisk finish.
sensory.mouthfeel_liquor: Relatively thin-bodied and delicate with no astringency. The liquor is a very pale, clear golden-yellow.
